description: How the wireframe canvas lays out its view at the first render, when the document is replaced and when the active page changes (decision WIREFRAME-INITIAL-ZOOM). It never overrides a zoom the user chose afterwards, not even when the container is resized.

values.name: Fit
values.description: The whole page is fitted into the canvas with a 40 px padding, but only ever shrunk: a page that fits at 100 % stays at exactly 100 % and is centred. The default.

values.name: ActualSize
values.description: The page is shown at 100 %. A page larger than the canvas starts at its top-left corner (padded); a smaller page is centred. This is the behaviour before the parameter existed for a page that fits.
